#!/bin/bash
set -e

# Install required system packages for the project
dist=$(lsb_release -si)
if [ "$dist" == "Ubuntu" ] || [ "$dist" == "Debian" ]; then
    apt-get update -yqq
    apt-get install -yqq \
        ninja-build libunwind-dev libboost-context-dev libssl-dev \
        autoconf-archive libtool cmake g++ bison zlib1g-dev
elif [ "$dist" == "Fedora" ]; then
    dnf install -y automake boost-devel g++ git cmake libtool ninja-build \
        openssl-devel libunwind-devel autoconf-archive patch bison libstdc++-static
elif [ "$dist" == "openSUSE" ]; then
    zypper install -y automake boost-devel gcc-c++ git cmake libtool ninja \
        openssl-devel libunwind-devel autoconf-archive patch bison \
        libboost_context-devel libboost_system-devel
elif [ "$dist" == "FreeBSD" ]; then
    pkg install -y git bash cmake ninja libunwind boost-libs autoconf automake libtool gmake bison
else
    echo "Unsupported distribution: $dist"
    exit 1
fi

# Clone the repository
if [ ! -d "dragonfly" ]; then
    git clone --recursive https://github.com/dragonflydb/dragonfly && cd dragonfly
else
    cd dragonfly
fi

# Configure the build
./helio/blaze.sh -release

# Build
cd build-opt && ninja dragonfly

# Install project dependencies
pip install -e .

# Run tests (replace with actual test command if provided)
# It's assumed pytest is the main testing framework
python -m pytest

# Step 4: Install dependencies from requirements.txt or setup.py or pyproject.toml

pyenv global $PYTHON_VERSION

    pip install -r requirements.txt

    pip install -e .

else

phpunit

#!/bin/bash

# Set the Python version based on repository requirements
PYTHON_VERSION="3.12.0"

# Install the specified Python version using pyenv
pyenv install -f $PYTHON_VERSION
pyenv global $PYTHON_VERSION

# Ensure pip, setuptools, and wheel are up to date
pip install --upgrade pip setuptools wheel

# Install system packages required for building the project
apt-get update -y && apt-get install -y \
    build-essential \
    libssl-dev \
    libffi-dev \
    libbz2-dev \
    libreadline-dev \
    libsqlite3-dev \
    liblzma-dev \
    libncurses5-dev \
    libncursesw5-dev \
    xz-utils \
    tk-dev \
    llvm \
    libxml2-dev \
    libxmlsec1-dev

# Install project dependencies (assuming pip and requirements.txt exists)
if [ -f requirements.txt ]; then
    pip install -r requirements.txt
elif [ -f setup.py ]; then
    pip install -e .
elif [ -f pyproject.toml ]; then
    pip install -e .
else
    echo "No dependency file found!"
    exit 1
fi

# Run the project's automated tests
# Assuming pytest is used for running tests
pytest
